global_events: Oil is the main overnight worry, with Brent above $95 a barrel, which weighs on India's import bill and has pushed the rupee down about 20 paise to roughly 92.40 per dollar in early trade. Forward premiums have jumped. Fresh US tariff-hike threats are pressuring trading partners to close deals, while India and China are signalling they will push back. US consumer confidence is firmer after the midterm elections, but inflation worries persist, and France faces recession risk.
central_banks: US inflation, on the Fed's preferred gauge, rose to 3.8% in October, raising the stakes for the Fed in 2027, and commentary is leaning toward further tightening. Spain's Pablo Hernández de Cos is reported set to take the helm at the ECB. In India, the RBI has flagged food inflation risks, and bonds sold off as oil climbed.
policy_sentiment: The RBI's warning on food inflation, together with tariff friction involving India and China, keeps the tone cautious for rate-sensitive sectors and importers.

research.why: Nature Nanotechnology demonstration of a hybrid core pairing VO2 Mott leaky integrate-and-fire neurons with domain-wall racetrack memory for event-driven spiking networks, a direct link between spintronic memory and neuromorphic computing.
research.title: Integration of Mott neurons and spintronic memories for event-driven spiking neural networks

research.why: Nature paper showing coherent parity oscillations between states encoded by four poor man's Majoranas in two coupled minimal Kitaev chains, a step toward topologically protected qubits.
research.title: Coherent parity oscillations in coupled minimal Kitaev chains

research.why: Nature Physics demonstration of two-qubit gates between interacting electron qubits on solid neon, advancing a new qubit platform.
research.title: Coherent manipulation of interacting electron qubits on solid neon

research.why: PRL identifies a Rashba-type interfacial spin-lattice coupling that produces kineoelasticity and nonreciprocal phonons, relevant to magnon-phonon physics and design.
research.title: Kineoelasticity and Nonreciprocal Phonons by Rashba-Induced Interfacial Spin-Lattice Coupling

research.why: PRL protocol for high-purity entanglement of distant spins through a magnon bus despite weak coupling, which breaks the usual fidelity-versus-decay trade-off and links magnonics to quantum information.
research.title: High-Purity Entanglement Mediated by Magnons Despite Weak Coupling

research.why: Nature paper on the AI platform ORIDTP, which de novo designs potent dual-target therapeutic peptides with strong in vivo efficacy, a high-impact AI-for-science result.
research.title: De novo design of high-potency dual-target therapeutic peptides with ORIDTP

research.why: PRL reports giant room-temperature magnetoelectric coupling in nanocomposite thin films through strain-sensitive polarization, relevant to voltage control of magnetism.
research.title: Giant Room-Temperature Magnetoelectric Coupling Effect in Nanocomposite Thin Films via Strain-Sensitive Polarization

research.why: Preprint demonstrating mode-resolved spin-wave (FMR) spectroscopy with a single NV center via the magnon Kerr effect, enabling nanoscale magnon sensing.
research.title: Mode-resolved spin-wave spectroscopy by a single paramagnetic center
